newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 26.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunker prices were steady as discussions were very thin after Christmas with some traders still away for holidays, trader said on Thursday. Indications were far apart early this morning, but narrowed to around Tuesday's quotes in thin volumes, a trader said. Most buyers have already covered their requirements before Christmas, he said.
